trickyParts: An existing stream with no id gets a deterministic id (sha256 of the stream name and its Created) so two racing first starts write one value; a new stream gets a random one; an existing id is never replaced.
An id-only update writes the stream's own config with the id added, so replicas and limits are kept; a real reconcile keeps today's desired config (INFRA-546 owns its replica handling).
Pending notices are restored only for known kinds, so a state written by a later build still parses.
